educators.title: Course and Resource Design for Educators | Hinova Design
educators.eyebrow: Course and resource design for educators
educators.heroTitle: Courses that are easier to teach and
heroParagraphs: Hinova helps educators and education teams plan courses, develop online lessons and design the materials that support teaching and learner practice.

We work from your syllabus, source content and learning goals to create lesson structures, activities, assessments and resources. When you need online delivery, we can also organise the course on Kajabi, Thinkific or Teachable.
educators.heroSupport: For tutors, schools, private academies, universities and education organisations.

needs.title: A syllabus sets the direction but the learning still needs to be designed
needs.intro: Your team may know what learners need to cover. The next step is deciding how to explain it, where learners will practise and how the materials will support delivery.
items: The syllabus is ready, but the lesson sequence or supporting resources are incomplete.
Presentations, worksheets and assessments have been created separately and need to align.
Educators are repeatedly rebuilding materials for the same course.
An online course needs clearer organisation before learners can use it.
needs.close: We work with your educators and subject-matter experts to develop the agreed course materials around the learning goals and the setting in which they will be used.

educators.servicesTitle: Support for the course and the people using it
educators.servicesIntro: We can help with the learning plan, the online course, the delivery setup or a specific set of resources. Each service is shaped around your audience and the agreed content.

services.title: Instructional Design and Course Planning
services.fit: You need to connect the learning goals with the course structure.
services.description: We review your syllabus and source material with your team, then map a sequence that links the content, learner activities and assessment.
details: Learning objectives and content organisation
Course outlines, lesson sequences and storyboards
Activities and assessments aligned with the agreed objectives
services.outcome: A learning plan that shows what will be taught, how learners will practise and how understanding will be checked.

services.title: Online Course Design and Development
services.fit: Approved content needs to become an online or blended course.
services.description: We develop lessons and resources for the learner group, using a consistent structure so the course is easier to navigate and deliver.
details: Lesson content and teaching presentations
Interactive learning activities, quizzes and supporting downloads
Review of existing courses for structure, consistency and usability
services.outcome: The agreed course materials, developed for your delivery format and ready for your team’s review.

services.title: Course Platform Setup and Support
services.fit: Your approved course needs to be organised for digital delivery.
services.description: We set up the agreed lesson structure in Kajabi, Thinkific or Teachable and check the course from the learner’s perspective.
details: Module and lesson setup with content uploads
Downloadable resources and learner access configuration
Checks of navigation, lesson order, links and downloads
services.outcome: A course area organised around the agreed learning sequence, with setup checks completed before handover.

services.title: Graphic and Document Design
services.fit: Educators and learners need well-organised resources for the course.
services.description: We design each document for its purpose, from introducing a topic to guiding a session or providing space for learner responses.
details: Workbooks, worksheets, journals, eBooks and learning guides
Teaching presentations, facilitator guides and course graphics
Interactive fillable PDFs and lead magnets for education businesses
services.outcome: Resources designed for the agreed print or digital format, with consistent layout and usable instructions.

educators.faqTitle: What your team may want to know

faq.question: Can you work with our current syllabus and materials?
faq.answer: Yes. We can work from a syllabus, lesson notes, presentations, existing resources or an online course. We review the starting point together before agreeing the scope.

faq.question: Who checks subject accuracy and curriculum alignment?
faq.answer: Your educators and subject-matter experts review and approve those areas. Hinova supports the learning structure, resource development, design and usability.

faq.question: Can we begin with one unit or resource?
faq.answer: Yes. The project can focus on one course, unit, workbook, presentation or another agreed resource. It does not need to cover an entire programme.

faq.question: Can you provide print and digital formats?
faq.answer: Yes. We agree how the resources will be used and which final or editable formats are needed before design begins.

faq.question: Which platforms do you support?
faq.answer: Our course setup support covers Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable. Share your delivery requirements so we can confirm whether this support fits your project.

faq.question: How are the schedule and cost agreed?
faq.answer: We consider the amount and readiness of the content, the deliverables, platform requirements and your internal review process. The proposal sets out the agreed scope, fee and milestones.

strategy.title: Let’s discuss what your educators and learners need
strategy.description: Share the course or resource you are working on, the learners it is for and what your team needs help with. We’ll discuss the materials you have and where Hinova’s planning, development or design support could fit.
topics: The learners, teaching context and intended learning goals
Your syllabus, source content and current resources
The deliverables and formats needed for delivery

strategy.note: You do not need a fully written brief. A syllabus, a few resources or a description of the learning challenge is enough to begin. There is no obligation to start a project.

strategy.alternativeDescription: Send your brief, current materials and delivery requirements so we can understand the support you need.

needs.intro: You may explain your ideas easily in a live session. Turning that conversation into lessons, activities and resources takes a different kind of work.

Your slides cover the ideas, but clients need a way to practise between sessions.

coaches.faqTitle: A few things you may want to know

faq.question: Do I need finished content before contacting you?
faq.answer: No. You can bring an outline, notes, existing slides or a course that needs updating. We’ll review what you have and agree what you need to supply and what we will develop.

faq.question: Can you help with just a workbook or presentation?
faq.answer: Yes. We can work on one resource, one part of a course or a wider project. The scope is built around the support you need.

faq.question: Will the course still sound like me?
faq.answer: Your expertise and approach guide the work. We use your source material and include review stages so you can check the language and accuracy before approval.

faq.question: Which platforms can you help with?
faq.answer: We provide course setup support for Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable, including agreed uploads, resources, access settings and learner-experience checks.

faq.question: Can I update the files afterwards?
faq.answer: We agree the editable and final formats before production. Let us know who will update the materials and which tools they use.

faq.question: How do you set the cost and timeline?
faq.answer: We consider the content available, lesson or page count, design requirements, platform work and review stages. Your proposal sets out the agreed fee, deliverables and schedule.
